name: How long does a typical whole-home remodel take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical whole-home remodel take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a whole-home remodel varies significantly based on the project's complexity and scope. A smaller remodel might take 3-6 months, while a more extensive renovation involving structural changes, multiple room reconfigurations, or additions could extend to 8-12 months or even longer. Factors like permitting processes, material lead times, and the decision-making speed of the homeowner also influence the timeline. We establish a realistic project schedule upfront and provide regular updates on progress.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical whole-home remodel can take anywhere from 3 months for smaller projects to over 12 months for extensive renovations, depending on scope and complexity.
